collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

the owner (2026-11-15): a person named by a role word is a cast villager and shows the name (flavor only: the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A villager squeezes an overripe mango and it bursts in a friend's face: apologize, laughing, or offer the friend the rest of it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is testing a mango to see whether it's ripe. It is. It is very ripe. It is so ripe that when (subject.he/she) gives it the gentlest squeeze, it bursts, and a jet of golden pulp shoots across the path and hits (friend) right in the face.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) holds out the burst mango sheepishly. (friend) takes it, looks (subject) in the eye, and squeezes. (subject) gets the other half. They stand facing each other, dripping and sticky. (child), a passing child, declares it the best thing that has happened all week.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) tries to say sorry, but can't stop laughing. (friend) slowly wipes the mango off (friend.his/her) face, tastes it, and says, "...That's actually a very good mango." They pick the rest of the tree together. (friend) squeezes every single mango in (subject)'s direction, "just to check."
